description.value:
When a weapon or tech power that requires a Dexterity saving throw or attack roll, and targets only you, would affect you, you can use your reaction to instantly open a pair of portals and reroute it toward another target within 30 feet. If it required a melee or ranged attack roll, make the appropriate melee or ranged tech attack roll against the new target; if it required a Dexterity save, the new target makes that save against your tech save DC instead.

Once used, you must finish a short or long rest before using this feature again.
